components.css: .ds-cmd{max-width:576px;border:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}.ds-cmd-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e5e5}.ds-cmd-tabs button{margin-bottom:-1px;padding:10px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:none;color:#737373;font:14px Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-cmd-tabs button:hover{color:#0a0a0a}.ds-cmd-tabs .on{border-bottom-color:#0a0a0a;color:#0a0a0a}.ds-cmd-line{padding:14px 16px}.ds-cmd-line code{font:14px 'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;color:#0a0a0a}.ds-cmd-line span{color:#737373}

narrative.overview: The docs and landing page sit beside ui.shadcn.com and Vercel's docs: white or near-black, neutral greys, hairlines, Geist, and the product's own live components as the only colour.

rules.name: The One Surface Rule
rules.body: Containers separate by a 1px hairline, never by a different background or a shadow.

rules.name: The Statement Rule
rules.body: Section headings are plain sentences stating a fact, with no label above them.

dos: Do render real components and commands
Do keep the action order: scaffolder, MCP, docs, star
donts: Don't use gradient glow, glass, seals, fake chats or decorative serifs
Don't use a grid of equal icon cards
